question: Which payment gateways does NatVPS offer at checkout to a buyer outside India, and does any of them take a card hold?
why: extras.payment_rails is unread because the gateway list appears only after registration; knowledge-base article 25 (https://clients.natvps.net/?/knowledgebase/article/25/i--039-m-from-india-and-paypal-isn--039-t-available-as-a-payment-method/, capture sha256:73090ecf19bb6eddd3fe3b404baa09073f80296ebda60bebbebee1a32310c012) states 'PayPal isn't available to Indian clients on NatVPS.', which implies PayPal is offered elsewhere but does not list the gateways
